We targeted the detection of 40 H3 K27-R40 variant × PTM combinations, including the mouse-specific variants H3mm7 and H3mm13, in histone samples extracted from mouse testis and brain via a parallel reaction monitoring analysis.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were propionylated and in-gel digested with trypsin.

For the  middle-down analyses, histones were extracted from mouse testis as described above and digested overnight with Glu-C endoprotease (V1651, New England BioLabs) at 37°C, at an enzyme:protein ratio of 1:20, in 0.05 M ammonium acetate (pH 4).
